title: Recent Release, "The Hidden Dimension," by C. A. Biggar, Reimagines the Sasquatch Legend Through Battle-Hardened Veterans Seeking Wilderness Redemption

content:
Pierre, SD, October 01, 2026 --(PR.com)-- C. A. Biggar has completed a new book, titled, "The Hidden Dimension," which follows three former special forces operatives as they retreat into the remote forest to escape the struggles of civilian reintegration after twenty-five years of military service across the globe. With minimal connections to ordinary life, these warriors embark on a solitary expedition, depending solely on one another for survival and purpose. Yet their isolated sanctuary harbors secrets far more profound than they anticipated, and the wilderness holds revelations that will irrevocably transform their destinies.

The author's lifelong fascination with science fiction, kindled by the original Star Trek series and nurtured through decades of enthusiasm for imaginative storytelling, culminates in this singular work. Biggar's passion for creatures of speculative fiction, particularly Sasquatch mythology, motivated him to craft a narrative that transcends conventional interpretations. Dissatisfied with repetitive plotlines dominating existing Sasquatch cinema, he channeled his vision into creating something refreshingly original.

"The Hidden Dimension" weaves themes of camaraderie, survival, and unexpected alliance into a riveting exploration of what emerges when duty-bound warriors confront forces beyond military training. Readers will discover how these three survivors forge an extraordinary bond that enables them to continue their life's calling, only to find themselves engaged in an unforeseen conflict alongside the most unlikely companions imaginable. The stakes escalate as these formidable men confront a reality that transcends their battlefield experience.

"I wanted to breathe fresh vitality into a legend that deserves more complexity than it typically receives," said Biggar. "These characters needed a profound discovery that would test not just their combat skills, but their humanity and capacity for connection beyond the military brotherhood they've always known."

Published by Christian Faith Publishing, C. A. Biggar's gripping work offers readers an imaginative escape that combines action-packed adventure with thoughtful exploration of redemption and purpose. This narrative promises to captivate fans of speculative fiction while delivering authentic character depth seldom seen in creature-feature storytelling.

Readers who wish to experience this thrilling work can purchase "The Hidden Dimension" at bookstores everywhere, or online at the Apple iTunes Store, Amazon, Google Play, or Barnes and Noble.
